reply.english: I'll lower the price a little.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.english: Peace be upon you.

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.english: And peace be upon you. Please, go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.english: How much is this shirt?

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.english: For twenty dinars.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.english: This is expensive. Is there a discount?

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.arabic: سَأُنْقِصُ السِّعْرَ قَلِيلًا. بِثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ دِينَارًا.
dialogue.english: I'll lower the price a little. For eighteen dinars.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.english: Do you have another color?

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.english: Yes, I have blue and red.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.english: The blue is nicer. What's the final price?

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.english: The final price is sixteen dinars.

dialogue.speaker: Sami
dialogue.english: Okay, deal.

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.english: Thank you.

response.english: I'll lower the price a little.
The final price is sixteen dinars.

lessons.culture: In a Fusha-speaking market, prices are asked with بِكَمْ and bargaining is polite: هَلْ يُوجَدُ خَصْم؟ is the standard way to ask for a reduction. Once both sides say اِتَّفَقْنَا, the deal is closed and it is not reopened.

exercises.prompt: A shopkeeper says: 'تَفَضَّلْ'. Ask how much this is.
exercises.tip: بِكَمْ is 'for how much'; it is the price question.

exercises.prompt: The price is too high for you. Say it is expensive and ask about a discount.
exercises.tip: Say what is wrong first, then ask for a reduction.

exercises.prompt: Complete: '_____ هَذَا؟' (How much is this?)
exercises.tip: بِ means 'for' and كَمْ means 'how much'.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'هَلْ عِنْدَكَ لَوْنٌ _____؟' (Do you have another color?)
exercises.tip: آخَر means 'another' and comes after the noun.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'I want this.'
exercises.tip: هَذَا is 'this' for a masculine thing, هَذِهِ for a feminine one.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'How much per kilo?'
exercises.tip: The price question بِكَمْ plus the unit.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'Do you have a smaller one?' (to a man)
exercises.tip: أَصْغَرُ مِنْ means 'smaller than'.

exercises.prompt: Which word means 'cheap'?
exercises.tip: غَالِي is the opposite: 'expensive'.

exercises.prompt: Which phrase means 'Final price'?
exercises.tip: النِّهَائِيّ means 'the last, final one'.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'قَلِيلًا / السِّعْرَ / أَنْقِصِ'.
exercises.tip: The command comes first, then what to lower, then how much.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'آخَر؟ / لَوْنٌ / عِنْدَكَ / هَلْ'.
exercises.tip: هَلْ opens the question, and آخَر ends it.

phrases.arabic: فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ تَأْتِي الْحَافِلَةُ غَدًا؟
phrases.transliteration: fee ayyi saa3atin ta2tee al-7aafilatu ghadan?

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.english: Are you free?

dialogue.speaker: Hamad
dialogue.english: Yes, at your service. Where to?

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.english: I want to go to the Old City.

dialogue.speaker: Hamad
dialogue.english: Please, get in.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.english: How long does the way take?

dialogue.speaker: Hamad
dialogue.english: About twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.english: And how much is the fare?

dialogue.speaker: Hamad
dialogue.english: Five dinars.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.arabic: حَسَنًا. هَلْ تُوصِلُنِي إِلَى الْمَحَطَّةِ أَوَّلًا؟
dialogue.english: Good. Will you drop me at the station first?

dialogue.speaker: Hamad
dialogue.english: Of course.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.english: Stop here, please.

dialogue.speaker: Hamad
dialogue.english: Here you are. Goodbye.

pair.english: How long does the way take?

pair.arabic: فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ تَأْتِي الْحَافِلَةُ غَدًا؟
pair.transliteration: fee ayyi saa3atin ta2tee al-7aafilatu ghadan?
pair.english: What time does the bus come tomorrow?

lessons.culture: A taxi in a Fusha-speaking city is reached with a short polite question, هَلْ أَنْتَ مُتَاح؟, and the driver answers فِي خِدْمَتِكَ. You name the place, agree the fare with كَمِ الْأُجْرَة؟ and end the ride with تَوَقَّفْ هُنَا، لَوْ سَمَحْتَ.

exercises.prompt: A taxi driver says: 'فِي خِدْمَتِكَ. إِلَى أَيْنَ؟'. Say you want to go to the Old City.
exercises.tip: أُرِيدُ الذَّهَابَ إِلَى means 'I want to go to'.

exercises.prompt: You reach your stop. Tell the driver, a man, to stop here, politely.
exercises.tip: The command form to a man is تَوَقَّفْ; add لَوْ سَمَحْتَ to be polite.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'كَمِ _____؟' (How much is the fare?)
exercises.tip: الْأُجْرَة is the fare or pay for a service.

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'هَلْ أَنْتَ _____؟' (Are you free? asking a taxi driver)
exercises.tip: مُتَاح means 'available'.

exercises.prompt: Translate into Fusha: 'I want to go to the station.'
exercises.tip: مَحَطَّة is 'station'.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'How long does the way take?'
exercises.tip: يَسْتَغْرِقُ means 'takes up' a length of time.

exercises.prompt: Translate: 'What time does the bus come tomorrow?'
exercises.answer: فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ تَأْتِي الْحَافِلَةُ غَدًا؟
accepted: فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ تَأْتِي الْحَافِلَةُ غَدًا؟
في أي ساعة تأتي الحافلة غدا؟
fee ayyi saa3atin ta2tee al-7aafilatu ghadan?
exercises.tip: فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ literally asks 'at which hour'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence asks a taxi driver 'Are you free?'
exercises.tip: The other sentences ask the fare, say stop, and ask where something is.

exercises.prompt: Which word means 'Busy / Occupied'?
exercises.tip: مُتَاح is the opposite: 'available'.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'الطَّرِيق؟ / يَسْتَغْرِقُ / الْوَقْتِ / مِنَ / كَمْ'.
exercises.tip: كَمْ first, then the time, then the verb, then the way.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: 'الْقَدِيمَة / الْمَدِينَةِ / إِلَى / الذَّهَابَ / أُرِيدُ'.
exercises.tip: 'I want' first, then 'to go', then 'to the Old City'.

challenge.title: Shop, then take a taxi
challenge.instructions: Write a short conversation in Fusha. First you buy something in a market: ask the price, say it is expensive, ask for a discount, ask for another color and agree on the final price. Then you call a taxi, ask if the driver is free, say where you want to go, ask the fare and tell the driver to stop.
required_elements: saying it is expensive and asking for a discount
asking for another color and choosing one
agreeing the final price with اِتَّفَقْنَا
asking a taxi driver if he is free and naming the place
asking the fare and telling the driver to stop

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.english: Peace be upon you. How much is this dress?

dialogue.speaker: Fawzi
dialogue.english: And peace be upon you. For fifty dinars.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.english: This is expensive. Is there a discount?

dialogue.speaker: Fawzi
dialogue.arabic: أَنْقَصْتُ السِّعْرَ قَلِيلًا. السِّعْرُ النِّهَائِيّ أَرْبَعُونَ دِينَارًا.
dialogue.transliteration: anqastu as-si3ra qaleelan. as-si3ru an-nihaa2ee arba3oona deenaran.
dialogue.english: I've lowered the price a little. The final price is forty dinars.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.english: Do you have another color?

dialogue.speaker: Fawzi
dialogue.english: Yes, I have blue and red.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.english: The red is nicer. Okay, deal.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.arabic: لَوْ سَمَحْتَ، هَلْ أَنْتَ مُتَاح؟ أُرِيدُ الذَّهَابَ إِلَى الْمَحَطَّة.
dialogue.transliteration: law samahta, hal anta mutaa7? ureedu adh-dhahaaba ilaa al-ma7atta.
dialogue.english: Excuse me, are you free? I want to go to the station.

dialogue.speaker: Hamad
dialogue.english: At your service. Please, get in.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.arabic: كَمِ الْأُجْرَة؟ وَتَوَقَّفْ هُنَا، لَوْ سَمَحْتَ.
dialogue.transliteration: kami al-ujra? wa tawaqqaf hunaa, law samahta.
dialogue.english: How much is the fare? And stop here, please.
